newsitem.title: USA: U.S. auto sales rise 2.5 pct Oct 1-10 -- CNW.
newsitem.headline: U.S. auto sales rise 2.5 pct Oct 1-10 -- CNW.

text.p: U.S. automobile sales rose 2.5 percent in the first ten days of October compared with the same period a year ago, according to a CNW Marketing/Research auto sales report.
Overall domestic vehicle sales totaled 256,265 for the period, against 286,666 in beginning-October 1995.
Domestic car sales climbed to 147,699 in the 10-day period, up from 143,536 in the same portion of 1995, CNW said. Import car sales rose to 31,888 from 29,614, it said.
Domestic truck sales totaled 108,566, versus 107,625 in the first part of October 1995, the report said. Import truck sales declined to 5,673 from 5,891, it said.
CNW said 34.7 percent of the vehicles were leased, up from 34.2 percent in the same survey period last year.
About 11.98 million vehicled have been sold in the United States so far in 1996, CNW said.
